title: The State public-works register: what the saved pages show
question: What do the State Department of Industrial Relations project pages saved for San Francisco awarding bodies show, and can they be joined to City payments?
finding: The four saved pages of the filtered search show 38 readable project numbers (the owner's note says the saved pages are the first 80 of 5,594 rows for 19 San Francisco awarding bodies). One project was opened in full: SFMTA Potrero Yard Modernization Project (Design / Build, San Francisco Municipal Transportation Agency, awarded 2026-03-24), listing 5 contractor entries. KPFF, INC. (listed as contractor): no City payment under this name; PHOENIX ELECTRIC COMPANY (listed as contractor): paid $7.1 million by the City since fiscal 2019; PRG - Potrero Properties LLC (listed as contractor): paid $65.0 million by the City since fiscal 2019; PRG - Potrero Properties LLC (listed as subcontractor): paid $65.0 million by the City since fiscal 2019; WEBCOR CONSTRUCTION L P (listed as contractor): paid $401.3 million by the City since fiscal 2019 as WEBCOR BUILDERS.
how: Project numbers are read from the printed result pages; the one detail page and its contractor list are read field by field. Contractors are matched to the Controller's payment and contract files on the normalised name, or on the first word of the name for a firm paid over $1 million (shown as "paid as"). Registration status is read from the two saved pages of the contractor search where the firm appears there.
limits: The saved pages are a sample: no export exists and the full PWC-100 list needs a records request (owner's note). The contractor search was by name, not location, and only 2 of about 117 pages were saved, so a status shown there may belong to another registration of the same firm. A design-build project lists its builder team at award; subcontractors are added later.

columns.t: Firm on the State project page
